title: Vaikor compact linguist proposal (v0.2)
description: Compact output of the companion linguist (Model -1, 0017 L3a): only the members the Core keeps, namely lang, intent, the required slots it does not give (missing, committed before the slots), slots and the optional follow-ups in then. The Core derives the full linguist envelope (linguist-envelope.schema.json, v0.1) from it with the catalog rules (0017 L2) and refuses any other member. A full v0.1 envelope is still accepted from a model trained on it. The catalog-specific schema that constrains decoding (0017 L8) is generated by the Core from the intent catalog and is narrower than this one. Status: Draft v0.2.

v.description: Version of the compact proposal; it tells the Core which form it reads.

intent.description: Catalog intent, or null when none fits.

missing.description: The intent's required slots the utterance does not give, in catalog order; empty for intent null. The model commits to it before it writes slots; the Core drops a slot listed here that is also given and derives missing_slots itself.

slots.description: Slot values given by the utterance, in canonical English, never a slot listed in missing. Names, quoted text, and file names stay verbatim.

then.description: Follow-up intents of a composition, in the order said (0017 §2c). Each pair must be declared in the catalog's compositions.
